aboutBody: Alert Server keeps an eye on air-raid alerts in the regions you choose and tells you in time, so you and your loved ones have more time to reach shelter. Alongside it you get a live threat map with the front line, a forecast and alert statistics. Data comes from alerts.in.ua and Neptun through the project's own server. Take care of yourself and never ignore an alert signal.

alertSourceProviderNote: This is a preferred source, not an exclusive one - if it fails a few times in a row, the app automatically switches to the next one in the list and retries the preferred source later. Neptun only reports region/district-level status (no individual communities) and no weapon type.
